entries.title: Titus 3:1
segments: ¶Remind them to be subject to rulers and authorities, to obey, to be ready for every good work,

entries.title: Titus 3:2
segments: to speak evil of no one, to be peaceable, gentle, showing all humility to all men.

entries.title: Titus 3:3
segments: For we ourselves were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful and hating one another.

entries.title: Titus 3:4
segments: But when the kindness and the love of God our Savior toward man appeared,

entries.title: Titus 3:5
segments: not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to His mercy He saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Titus 3:6
segments: whom He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,

entries.title: Titus 3:7
segments: that having been justified by His grace we should become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

entries.title: Titus 3:8
segments: This is a faithful saying, and these things I want you to affirm constantly, that those who have believed in God should be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men.

entries.title: Titus 3:9
segments: ¶But avoid foolish disputes, genealogies, contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and useless.

entries.title: Titus 3:10
segments: Reject a divisive man after the first and second admonition,

entries.title: Titus 3:11
segments: knowing that such a person is warped and sinning, being self-condemned.

entries.title: Titus 3:12
segments: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there.

entries.title: Titus 3:13
segments: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey with haste, that they may lack nothing.

entries.title: Titus 3:14
segments: And let our [people] also learn to maintain good works, to [meet] urgent needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

entries.title: Titus 3:15
segments: All who [are] with me greet you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace [be] with you all. Amen.
